assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the two reviewed items curated on tomozaki:ashigaru@light-novel at basis_commit, each read in full: #bounded-character-dossier, the canonical B-scope Ashigaru bounded character dossier (INDEPENDENT_BOUNDED_LITERARY_SCOPE_PASS, maturity BOUNDED_INDIVIDUAL_LITERARY_ROLE) over the locked Japanese main V01-V12 with routed V06.5/V08.5, whose positive person evidence lies in V08-V12 and whose routes AS-P01 to AS-P11 are fresh primary windows in V08, V09, V10, V11 and V12, with the other audit cells retained as unknown rather than absence findings; and #bounded-reconstruction-model, the canonical derived-use model TOMOZAKI_ASHIGARU_B08_MODEL_V1, marked do_not_use_as_primary_literary_authority, which derives from the dossier and is not used as literary evidence. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method and gate state only. The supporting character implementation review, the supporting literary evidence manifest, the six-pilot integration review and evidence packet, the readings and the ledgers are not curated on this subject and are not evidence here. Ashigaru is a public handle; no legal name is established. Observation is predominantly Fumiya's. No adaptation, performed voice, reception or post-V12 material is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's eight selectors: AS08_REQUESTED_OPPONENT and AS08_ROUTE_ADVISER (V08), AS09_CONFIDENCE_PEER and AS09_RELATIONSHIP_TALK (V09), AS10_INTERMEDIARY (V10), AS11_COMMENTATOR_RECRUITER and AS11_FAN_SELF_REPORT (V11, with the school role still future), and AS12_ACTUAL_GUEST (V12, with the exhibition result unshown). Earlier volumes are unknown review cells; the V11 report of another job is not Fumiya's earlier knowledge; nothing after V12 is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The dossier's governing account, linking competitive craft to an occasion, audience and practical exchange, with positive ends (good competition, scene renewal, new participants, game pleasure) alongside tactical pressure and a taste for embarrassment (sections 1 and 11, AS-E01 to E12), is operationalized as model mechanisms AM1-AM7. C is rejected because section 1 states that Ashigaru's private life, complete career and interior are too thinly supplied for a broadly predictive reconstruction, and the model rates new recruitment decisions and hidden motives as weaker. E is rejected because the account is corroborated across eleven fresh primary windows and tested against seven named rival readings (section 11).

The section 2 band table gives five clocked bands, V08 to V12, each with a boundary, and the model's eight selectors keep the V11 agreed school role separate from the V12 actual appearance. C is rejected because the bands are role configurations rather than developmental states, earlier volumes are unknown cells, and the only developmental account is Ashigaru's own retrospective V11 self-report about changing reasons (AS-P10), which the dossier says is not an independently witnessed chronology. E is rejected because five located bands with explicit clocks exist.

Register contrast is located: an offstage dry, flat manner observed by Fumiya, a gaming idiom that Hinami and Rena tease as needing translation into ordinary Japanese (V09 part0020 P410-600), a brighter public commentary voice (V11 p-0028 P140-209), jokes that do not land equally with Kikuchi and Mimimi, and a timed anecdote that gets the gym laughing (V12 p-0026 P177-258); model section 'Ordinary pleasure, register and failures' records these as local role constraints. C is rejected because the curated items quote no speech, no idiolect, pitch or prosody is established and the model generates no freeform Japanese. E is rejected because contrast across offstage, peer and public registers is primary-located.

Ordinary acts are located: animated pleasure at Buin and its remembered catchphrase (V10 part0015), quietly paying the café bill while ostensibly leaving for the bathroom (V10 part0017 P54-83), and teasing about embarrassing history (V08). C is rejected because these are incidental to professional scenes, and the dossier establishes no household, routine, unnamed job, favorite-game hierarchy or wealth. E is rejected because several located acts show his own ordinary pleasure and generosity.

The section 11 recipient table gives distinct conduct and a limit for each of eleven recipients or domains (Fumiya as opponent, aspirant and interlocutor; Rena and Hinami; Harry and Max; Endo; Mizusawa; Mimimi; Kikuchi; Shimaaji; the school audience and organizers), each routed to AS-P windows, and the model's selectors partition role and knowledge. B is rejected because most recipients rest on one or two windows, the histories of his friendships and personal relationships are not established, and the model rates changed professional relationships as weaker. D is rejected because the variation is explicit and primary-located across many recipients.

Ashigaru's interior is reached only through Fumiya's observation and Ashigaru's own addressed speech: the dossier warns that an unreadable flat expression is evidence about what Fumiya sees, and the strongest window is the V11 self-report of having been unexpectedly glad and embarrassed at being moved by admirers (p-0030 P154-295). D is rejected because there is no focalization of Ashigaru and section 1 calls his interior too thinly supplied. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because a direct self-report of feeling is located.

Conflict and pressure behavior is located: full-effort competition with a small embarrassment wager and a pressure read that wins the set (V08 part0030 P1-386), pressing Endo for an idea after an infeasible request (V10 part0015), redirecting Mimimi's protest into a novice-commentary role and later apologizing for extending it (V11 p-0030 P1-153), and asking to broadcast an embarrassing incident, which Fumiya refuses (same window). C is rejected because no high-stakes interpersonal conflict occurs and the model states that no complete internal stopping rule is established. E is rejected because several distinct modes are located.

Located normative reasoning in Ashigaru's own speech includes treating parental support, time and money as real stakes in a career route (V08 part0030 P387-533), refusing to call gamer individualism morally wrong while predicting that unequal desires for closeness can hurt people (V09 part0020 P410-600), and asking reciprocal contributions rather than a fee from a junior (V11 p-0030). C is rejected because these are local situated judgments without tested dilemmas, and the dossier keeps them attributed views rather than a moral model. E is rejected because explicit normative distinctions are located across three volumes.

Play is located across volumes: the mutual embarrassment wager and departure teasing (V08), jokes about his handle and Fumiya's female company (V11 p-0028), the novice-commentary contrast staged for entertainment (V11 p-0030) and the timed zero-revenue anecdote (V12 p-0026); the dossier names a taste for other people's embarrassment. C is rejected because no humor style is analysed beyond that taste and the jokes are reported rather than quoted. E is rejected because humor is located in four bands.

The dossier is an independently accepted B-scope account with fresh primary windows AS-P01 to AS-P11 across every positive band V08-V12; the audit retains nine unknown cells and five meaningful later cells. C is rejected because section 1 states that the evidence does not support a principal-scale longitudinal monograph and that private biography, detailed work and economics, full personal relationships and an exhaustive idiolect remain unknown. E is rejected because every positive band has fresh primary windows.

Affirmative limits are located: the hundred-game estimate is his prospective judgment, not a record (AS-P02/P03); Endo retains constraints and labor (AS-P06); Ashigaru's presence at the Rena meeting does not prevent later intrusion (AS-P04); Fumiya refuses the broadcast request and broadcasting is not shown; the novice commentary carries a no-face condition and an extension apology (AS-P09); the organizers neglected preparation (AS-P11). B is rejected because several limits are epistemic gaps (improvisation, fee loss, the exhibition result) rather than affirmative evidence, and each limit rests on one scene. D is rejected because the limits are explicit and primary-located.

Each band and selector binds a clock and actor knowledge: the V11 job report is not assigned to Fumiya's V08 knowledge, the V11 agreed role and V12 actual appearance stay separate, and shared Buin memory does not supply the students' school-specific history. B is rejected because only V08-V12 are covered, earlier volumes are unknown cells, and the start of his other job is unknown. D is rejected because clock and knowledge controls are explicit for every selector.

scenario_readiness.note: The model generates no freeform Japanese and records register only as local role constraints; the curated items quote no speech and establish no idiolect, pitch or prosody. CONDITIONAL would treat role-register contrasts as a voice. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the evidence explicitly bounds voice.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One of the model selectors AS08_REQUESTED_OPPONENT to AS12_ACTUAL_GUEST within Japanese V08-V12, with the V11 school role still future at AS11 and the V12 exhibition result unshown; earlier volumes are unknown cells and nothing after V12 is established.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested recipients in their represented standing: Fumiya as opponent, aspirant and interlocutor, Rena and Hinami in group talk, Harry and Max, Endo, Mizusawa, Mimimi, Kikuchi, Shimaaji, and the school audience and organizers.
setting_constraints: Competitive game play under stated format and stakes, situated professional-route talk, network introduction and negotiated community or school events only
No private life, household, romance, finances, sponsorship, market facts or severe crisis
Participation, image and voice permissions and other people's labor must be supplied; output would be a labeled hypothetical range, never an observed canonical event

scenario_readiness.note: Section 11 of the dossier states that it supports bounded comparison domains rather than new scenario outputs, and the model rates new recruitment decisions, unseen audience responses, hidden motives and changed professional relationships as weaker. CONDITIONAL would generate materially novel scenarios from a B-scope account whose private life and interior are unavailable. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the evidence explicitly bounds scenario transfer.

Ordinary acts (Buin pleasure, the paid bill, teasing) occur only inside professional or advisory scenes, and no private life, routine or household is established. CONDITIONAL would build ordinary social behavior from incidental acts. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the ordinary acts are located and explicitly limited.

Ashigaru's normative statements are located local judgments, and the model treats permission and stopping only as negotiated local boundaries without an internal rule. CONDITIONAL would generate deliberation in new dilemmas from attributed opinions. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the statements are directly evidenced.

Ashigaru offers attributed team and individualist models of romance to others, but section 6 states that no evidence settles his own romantic status, partners or history, and the model excludes universal romance authority. CONDITIONAL would invent his romantic conduct from his views on Fumiya's. NOT_ASSESSED is rejected because the dossier explicitly bounds the domain.

conditions: One named selector only (AS08_REQUESTED_OPPONENT, AS08_ROUTE_ADVISER, AS10_INTERMEDIARY, AS11_COMMENTATOR_RECRUITER or AS12_ACTUAL_GUEST), with its actor knowledge.

Role, audience, request, format, stakes, agreed conditions, participation and image or voice scope, and other people's capacity and labor are supplied; an extension without renewed assent is marked outside the original permission.
No income, sponsorship, market facts, talk preparation or improvisation, fee loss, career guarantee or match result is invented; another professional's expertise and labor stay independent.
Output is a qualitative prose range naming who bears the labor and what is abstained, not generated canonical dialogue.
scenario_readiness.note: Professional and community work is the dossier's positive field: competition under stated conditions (AM1), situated route advice (AM2), network introduction with friction (AM4) and audience-facing programming with permission costs (AM5, AM7), which the model names among its relatively firmer fields. READY is rejected because economics, market facts, unseen preparation, new recruitment decisions and match results are outside scope or weaker. NOT_READY is rejected because the field is model-admitted and primary-located across V08-V12.

known_limits.statement: Ashigaru's V08 claim that Fumiya would probably win more over a hundred games is his prospective comparative judgment, not a completed experiment, and one decisive set is not a ranking.
The V08 pressure read that wins the set is situated strategic work on this opponent, which Fumiya recognizes; it is not mind-reading, a clinical diagnosis or a rule for every risky move.
In V10 Ashigaru presses Endo for an idea after an infeasible request; Endo retains the judgment of what can be done, and Mizusawa produces the eventual exchange.
Ashigaru's presence at the V09 meeting with Rena as a local buffer does not prevent her later intrusion or establish a boundary policy.
In V11 Ashigaru asks whether he may tell an embarrassing incident on stream and Fumiya refuses; the source does not show him broadcasting it, and the exchange is not a complete privacy policy.

Mimimi's novice commentary begins over her protest under a stated no-face condition, continues beyond the first game, and later draws Ashigaru's apology; favorable reception does not erase the pressure.
Ashigaru's V11 report that he also works an unnamed ordinary job cannot be assigned to Fumiya's earlier knowledge and does not show when the job began.

Ashigaru's account of changing reasons through admirers' belief is his own retrospective self-report, not an independently witnessed conversion to altruism; competition and scene-building aims persist.
The V12 school talk follows organizer neglect of preparation; the zero-revenue anecdote is testimony, not audited finances, and the proposed exhibition's result is unshown.
Legal name, age, education, household, employer, salary, sponsorship and romantic status are not established.
Volumes before V08 are unknown review cells in the fourteen-witness audit, not findings of absence.
Whether the V12 talk was improvised or prepared, and any fee loss or later professional consequence, are unestablished.
No idiolect, pitch, prosody or performed voice is established; no freeform Japanese or blind accuracy is validated.
Nothing after the V12 boundary is evidenced.
